overall_reason: A clear, specific architecture diagram (named services, real paths like 'src/content/*.mdx', one focal node, one accent for the primary flow) in a deliberate house style; the weak spots are decorative numbering that collides with labels and chrome (tag chips, eyebrow, 8-item legend) that outweighs a 5-node graph.

findings.where: Cloudflare node ('01') and Astro Origin node ('02')
findings.evidence: 32px pale mono watermarks '01' and '02' sit in the bottom-right of two nodes and overlap the sub-labels ('cache' runs into '01', 'MDX' into '02') in tile 1440-00. T-DELETION: removing them loses nothing; only two of five nodes are numbered and the order is already shown by arrows.
findings.why: Decorative step numbering that collides with real labels is template chrome.

findings.evidence: T-DIAGRAM-EARNS is borderline: five nodes in one chain with a fork ('Reader -> Cloudflare -> Astro Origin, which reads the MDX bundle and queries the CMS') fit in one sentence, and the svg's own <desc> says exactly that. The diagram earns its place only if it shows what prose cannot (cache hit vs miss, build-time vs request-time reads).
findings.after: Show the cache-hit return from Cloudflare and mark whether 'READ MDX' happens at build or per request [DATA NEEDED: build vs runtime read]
findings.why: Draw a diagram only if it out-teaches a paragraph.

findings.where: node tag chips 'EXT', 'EDGE', 'ORIG', 'BUN', 'CMS' and the 'CONTENT' group label
findings.evidence: Each node carries a 7-8px mono chip repeating its type or name ('CMS' above 'Content CMS'); types are also given by fill in the 8-item legend. T-LABEL-TRANSFORM: the chips add no fact the node title or legend does not.
findings.before: Chip + title + subtitle per node, 8-item legend
findings.after: Drop the chips (or the legend's node-type rows) so each fact appears once; legend keeps only arrow meanings
findings.why: Doubled labelling is chrome that crowds a small diagram.

findings.evidence: The diagram occupies a 230px-tall strip; ~160px of empty dotted grid separates the title from the first node and the svg is 576px tall for a 300px drawing.
findings.before: svg height 576 with nodes in the lower half
findings.after: Crop the viewBox to the drawing plus margin so the title sits with the diagram

strengths: Specific, real content: 'Astro Origin SSR + MDX', 'Cloudflare Pages · cache', 'src/content/*.mdx', 'assets · og images'; nothing generic.
One focal node in the accent colour and one accent arrow for the primary SSR path; return path dashed, so flow reads in under 30 seconds (T-30S-BOARD passes).
not_investigated: Correctness of the architecture itself (whether MDX is read at runtime) not verifiable from the artifact.
